name: create_relation
description: Create a typed edge between two memory nodes. Supports relation types: relates_to, depends_on, implements, references, similar_to, contains. Edges have weights (0-1) that decay over time via e^(-λt). Duplicate edges update weight instead of creating new ones.

source_id.description: ID of the source memory node.

target_id.description: ID of the target memory node.

weight.description: Edge weight 0-1. Higher = stronger relationship. Default: 1.0.

metadata.description: Optional key-value metadata for the edge.
